items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: So they brought 5 or 6 musicians; you know, Ben Webster and then came with Blanton... I invited everybody from the clubs... But the big thing was that Lunceford Luntz was in town, and Duke was in town... They got 5 or 6 men from each one of their bands... and we would close it, you know.

ctx.x: It was a resort, yes. And so we went up to Val Verdi and sure enough, now they were in trouble -- because they had these drum solos down there, and they didn't have anyone to show Mickey what was done. Okay, so this big black limo that they use in studios -- I'm sure you've seen them, you know -- here's a chauffeur and the Head of the music department out there looking for me. So Blanton and I saw him, you know, because you're really crazy when you're young, you know, and he said, 'Hey, there he is!' And so I'm…
do it, but I got to be paid for it."
